description: Vision-assisted pre-labels sampled every 3 seconds across all four selectable hiking/park clips. Coordinates are source-frame XYXY pixels; classes use COCO ids.
reason: Most boxes are YOLO26n proposals and are not independently verified instance by instance. Visual audit found missed people and one false vehicle; this file must be reviewed before recall/precision scoring.
sampling: 1s start, then every 3s to clip end (84 frames total)
review_notes: Vehicle proposal at grand-canyon-guided-hike-2.mp4 37s was a false car label on a partial hiker/backpack and was excluded.
The visual audit found missed people in Acadia clips; zero model boxes do not mean zero ground-truth objects.
No positive vehicle examples were visually confirmed in the sampled frames.
